purpose: Validate the Branch invalid-peak no-action refusal fix with a Release build, targeted C++ tests, the full integration target, and one capped W04 BR480 run.

source_provenance.note: The isolated .17 source clone was older than the local branch. The current local PulseLib snapshots needed for this investigation and the current root integration-test file were overlaid from a verified archive before building. This validates those overlaid files, but is not a complete checkout of the local root commit.

full_target.termination: SIGSEGV after Google Test reported all 33 tests passed
full_target.interpretation: The test host failed during static application teardown. Its root cause remains unclassified; the process exit is not clean and the full target cannot yet be reported as passing.

full_target_followup.purpose: Check whether explicitly calling UApplication::UnInit before static destruction makes the full integration binary exit cleanly.
full_target_followup.temporary_change: Test_PulseLib_Main called ShutdownEngineForPulseLibTests after RUN_ALL_TESTS; that helper called UApplication::UnInit and cleared global UEPtr references. This test-only change was reverted after it failed to produce a reliable full run.

first_release_build.failure: Compilation rejected assignment of empty braced temporaries to legacy UEPtr because its operator= takes non-const lvalue references; no binary was run.

full_target_followup.interpretation: The explicit-shutdown experiment did not resolve the test target. The changed binary failed in a different place; this does not establish that the lifecycle change caused the crash. Current full-target instability may involve test-harness memory corruption or environment sensitivity and remains unclassified. The temporary lifecycle patch was reverted; no more full-target runs were started.

status.stop_reason: The diagnostic harness reached its 12-poll observation cap and sent SIGTERM; this was not a C++ training refusal.

conclusion.confirmed: The four C++ tests pass, including timing-within-tolerance, three-cycle refusal and W3 Rmax exception contracts.
conclusion.not_confirmed_by_training_run: The capped W04 run did not reproduce repeated invalid-peak/no-action behavior, reach Rmin, or converge. It therefore does not validate the runtime refusal path.
conclusion.separate_observation: A finite active peak up to 5.69e8 was marked valid by the current lower-bound-only peak predicate; the model-based upper-validity criterion remains open.
conclusion.scope_limit: The four target Branch regression tests exit cleanly, but the full integration executable has two non-clean runs with different SIGSEGV stacks. The test-host/memory issue remains unclassified and no further runs were started after the second crash.
